answer: Cross-account similarity screening: each epoch the ledger embeds every answer and compares them pairwise, acting like a prism that splits a batch into distinct meanings so clones collapse into one band. If two identities submit texts that echo each other above a threshold, both payouts are withheld and their bonds slashed. A farmer running 100 sybils must then pay for 100 genuinely distinct reasoning passes instead of polishing one jade template, so each fake identity costs as much compute as a real one.
